	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_social_democrat_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		# Agitator ideologies should disapprove of a current law
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_old_age_pension
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections
			}
		}
		interest_group ?= {
			ideology_social_democrat_valid_trigger = yes
		}
	}
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = {
			add = 100
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		# More likely if issues are relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner.ideology_social_democrat_disfavoured_laws > 0
			}
			add = {
				value = owner.ideology_social_democrat_disfavoured_laws
				multiply = 10 # Caste laws don't count by default
				desc = "DISFAVORED_LAWS"
			}
		}
		# very angry IG's more likely to turn to more radical socialism
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_devout } # can't be radical socialists
				ig_approval <= define:NPolitics|APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_UNHAPPY
			}
			add = {
				value = -75
				desc = "IG_APPROVAL_BELOW_UNHAPPY"
			}
		}
		# more likely for content devout in council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				ig_approval > 0
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 75
				desc = "CONTENT_IN_CR"
			}
		}
		# more likely for content trade unions outside of council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				ig_approval > 0
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 75
				desc = "CONTENT_TU"
			}
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "DREYFUSARD_VICTORY"
			}
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the liberals.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_liberal_victory
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "SPA_LIBERAL_VICTORY"
			}
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you succeed in Portugal's Second Liberalism.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = por_second_liberalism_victory
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "POR_LIBERAL_VICTORY"
			}
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Hungarian Revolution was successful.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = hungarian_revolution_increased_liberalism
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "HUNGARIAN_REVOLUTION"
			}
		}
		# Pedro JE victory
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = brz_enduring_empire
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "BRZ_ENDURING_EMPIRE"
			}
		}
		# extremely unlikely for trade unions in council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.01
				desc = "COUNCIL_REPUBLIC_LAW"
			}
		}
		# National Liberation Alliance
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = national_liberation_alliance_variable
					has_journal_entry = je_new_republic
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.20
				desc = "NATIONAL_LIBERATION_ALLIANCE"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_variable = communist_ig_var
					has_variable = chose_vanguardism
					has_variable = chose_anarchism
					has_variable = chose_communism
					has_variable = chose_ethno_nationalism
					has_variable = chose_conservatism
					has_variable = chose_fascism
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.1
				desc = "CHOSE_A_DIFFERENT_PATH"
			}
		}
	}
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# More likely if issues are relevant
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner.ideology_social_democrat_disfavoured_laws > 0
			}
			add = {
				value = owner.ideology_social_democrat_disfavoured_laws
				multiply = 10 # Caste laws don't count by default
			}
		}
		# very angry IG's more likely to turn to more radical socialism
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_devout } # can't be radical socialists
				interest_group.ig_approval <= define:NPolitics|APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_UNHAPPY
			}
			add = -75
		}
		# more likely for content devout in council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				interest_group.ig_approval > 0
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# more likely for content trade unions outside of council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				interest_group.ig_approval > 0
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the liberals and choose to have woke commanders.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				has_variable = spa_liberal_military_var
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# extremely unlikely for trade unions in council republic
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.01
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				interest_group ?= {
					OR = {
						has_variable = communist_ig_var
						has_variable = chose_vanguardism
						has_variable = chose_anarchism
						has_variable = chose_communism
						has_variable = chose_ethno_nationalism
						has_variable = chose_conservatism
						has_variable = chose_fascism
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.1
		}
	}
}

# REPLACE: changes vanilla stances in lawgroup_rights_of_women (law_womens_suffrage)
REPLACE:ideology_feminist = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ideology_icons/ideology_leader/ideology_leader_womens_liberation.dds"
	character_ideology = yes
	lawgroup_family_reproductive_policy = {
		law_traditional_family_structure = strongly_disapprove
		law_pro_natalist_subsidies = strongly_disapprove
		law_state_sponsored_family_planning = strongly_approve
		law_population_control_measures = strongly_disapprove
		law_communal_child_rearing = approve
	}
	lawgroup_LGBTQ_rights = {
		law_active_persecution = strongly_disapprove
		law_legal_limbo = disapprove
		law_basic_protections = neutral
		law_comprehensive_rights = approve
		law_full_equality_and_protection = strongly_approve
	}
	lawgroup_rights_of_women = {
		law_protected_class = strongly_approve
		law_womens_suffrage = approve
		law_women_in_the_workplace = neutral
		law_women_own_property = disapprove
		law_no_womens_rights = strongly_disapprove
	}
	country_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = feminism
	}
	interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		ideology_feminist_valid_trigger = yes
	}
	non_interest_group_leader_trigger = {
		# Agitators should have an ideology at odds with current laws
		NAND = {
			has_role_of_type = agitator
			owner = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_womens_suffrage
			}
		}
		interest_group ?= {
			ideology_feminist_valid_trigger = yes
		}
	}
	interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = {
			add = 100
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		# Less likely if women already have rights
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_womens_suffrage
						AND = {
							country_has_voting_franchise = no
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_women_in_the_workplace
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "FAVORED_LAWS"
			}
		}
		# more likely with limited women's rights
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_womens_rights
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_women_own_property
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "DISFAVORED_LAWS"
			}
		}
		# less likely if humanitarian is an option
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "HUMANITARIAN_AVAILABLE"
			}
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Dreyfusards won.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = dreyfusard_victory
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "DREYFUSARD_VICTORY"
			}
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the liberals.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = spa_two_spains_liberal_victory
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "SPA_LIBERAL_VICTORY"
			}
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you succeed in Portugal's Second Liberalism.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = por_second_liberalism_victory
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "POR_LIBERAL_VICTORY"
			}
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if the Hungarian Revolution was successful.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = hungarian_revolution_increased_liberalism
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "HUNGARIAN_REVOLUTION"
			}
		}
		# Pedro JE victory
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = brz_enduring_empire
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "BRZ_ENDURING_EMPIRE"
			}
		}
		# more likely if character is a woman after mass propaganda
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = mass_propaganda
				}
				leader ?= {
					is_female = yes
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "FEMALE_IG_LEADER"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_variable = communist_ig_var
					has_variable = chose_vanguardism
					has_variable = chose_anarchism
					has_variable = chose_communism
					has_variable = chose_ethno_nationalism
					has_variable = chose_conservatism
					has_variable = chose_fascism
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.1
				desc = "CHOSE_A_DIFFERENT_PATH"
			}
		}
	}
	non_interest_group_leader_weight = {
		value = 100
		# Less likely if women already have rights
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_womens_suffrage
						AND = {
							country_has_voting_franchise = no
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_women_in_the_workplace
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = -50
		}
		# more likely with limited women's rights
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_womens_rights
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_women_own_property
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
			}
		}
		# less likely if humanitarian is an option
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
			}
			add = -25
		}
		# liberal and/or radical leaders have a higher spawn chance if you win the Two Spains as the liberals and choose to have woke commanders.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_role_of_type = general
					has_role_of_type = admiral
				}
				has_variable = spa_liberal_military_var
			}
			add = 50
		}
		# more likely if character is a woman after mass propaganda
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = mass_propaganda
				}
				is_female = yes
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				interest_group ?= {
					OR = {
						has_variable = communist_ig_var
						has_variable = chose_vanguardism
						has_variable = chose_anarchism
						has_variable = chose_communism
						has_variable = chose_ethno_nationalism
						has_variable = chose_conservatism
						has_variable = chose_fascism
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.1
		}
	}
}
